HediffDef.label: crossfire core
HediffDef.description: Fires along a locked lane, then sweeps across the original target position. Each beat has its own warning; neither follows your movement. Focus fire or existing control can interrupt the sequence. Interrupting, dodging or fully shielding both beats exposes the core for 4 seconds, increasing damage taken by 25%. If a beat inflicts wounds, the opening lasts 1.5 seconds instead. Ordinary weapons and movement are enough; no machinery or special skill is required. Earn personal damage or actual shield and healing contribution before defeating the core.
